summary: A new hire asks whether they can send the team a short note saying who they are and what they do.
realLife: Advice for first weeks suggests that if nobody has arranged introductions, the newcomer can ask their boss to let them email or message the team about themselves.
sources: Atlassian Work Life, starting a new job and first week success: https://www.atlassian.com/blog/teamwork/starting-a-new-job-and-first-week-success
inGame: New-coworker event when someone is hired where the player works; the newcomer's name and position come from the job record (employer, position, workplace, pay, tenure) in the jobs module.
